subject: How to reorder ggplot bar chart in Rstudio markdown?

messages.author: dd355fe54ba071d5
messages.subject: How to reorder ggplot bar chart in Rstudio markdown?
parts:
Colleagues.


I have the following code which generates an ordered bar chart in the Rstudio graphics window. However, when I run this code in Rstudio markdown to generate an html file or wordfile, the bars do not come out ordered by count. What am I missing?

qplot(reorder(vag, n), n, data = a, fill = gender) +
        geom_bar(stat = 'identity')+
        scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
        ggtitle("Gender by VAG")+
        xlab("")+
        ylab("Total") +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))+
        guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))
